summary: Tested bug fixes for N2O/CO2e formula detection and new Applicable Scopes feature. All 5 features verified successfully - N2O formula now detected (key changed from 'n20_emissions' to 'n2o_emissions'), CO2e formula created ('co2e_emissions'), and scopes UI working in both form and list views.

issues: Minor React hydration warning in console (span inside option/select) - cosmetic, does not affect functionality

n2o_formula_detection.details: N2O formula now has correct key 'n2o_emissions' (fixed from 'n20_emissions'). UI shows formula in calculation details without 'No N₂O formula defined' error.

co2e_formula_detection.details: CO2e formula exists with key 'co2e_emissions'. UI shows CO2e calculation using dynamic GWP values (CH4=25, N2O=273). No 'No CO₂e formula defined' error.

applicable_scopes_form.details: Formula form has 'Applicable Scopes' section with checkboxes for Scope 1, Scope 2, and Biogenic.

applicable_scopes_badges.details: Formula list displays applicable scopes as purple badges. N2O shows 'Scope 1', CO2e shows 'Scope 1', 'Scope 2', 'Biogenic'.

applicable_scopes_api.details: Backend API supports applicable_scopes field in FormulaDefinitionCreate/Response models. Create and update operations preserve scope selections.

rca_of_the_issue.original_issue_1: N2O formula showing 'No N₂O formula defined' despite being defined
rca_of_the_issue.root_cause_1: Formula key was 'n20_emissions' (with zero) instead of 'n2o_emissions' (with letter O). Frontend lookup was checking for 'n2o' patterns.
rca_of_the_issue.fix_applied_1: Main agent renamed formula key from 'n20_emissions' to 'n2o_emissions' and updated frontend to also check for 'n20' variations as fallback.
rca_of_the_issue.original_issue_2: CO2e formula showing 'No CO₂e formula defined'
rca_of_the_issue.root_cause_2: No CO2e formula was defined in the database
rca_of_the_issue.fix_applied_2: Main agent created new 'co2e_emissions' formula with all applicable scopes
rca_of_the_issue.new_feature: Applicable Scopes allows formulas to be assigned to specific scopes (Scope 1, Scope 2, Biogenic)
